description: Source code for API request handling in Playwright, including classes for APIRequest, APIRequestContext, and APIResponse, with methods for HTTP operations, request configuration, and response processing.

classes.name: APIRequest
classes.description: Main class for creating and managing API request contexts, including creating new request contexts.

classes.name: APIRequestContext
classes.description: Represents a specific API request context, providing methods for HTTP verbs, fetch, and storage state management.

classes.name: APIResponse
classes.description: Encapsulates an HTTP response, providing methods to access status, headers, body, and JSON content.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new API request context with specified options.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the request context, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with specified options.

methods.name: _innerFetch
methods.description: Internal method to handle fetch logic, including request setup and response handling.

methods.name: storageState
methods.description: Retrieves or saves the storage state, optionally writing to a file.
